answer: Identity activation costs a verifiable compute puzzle seeded by the epoch, roughly one minute per key, and the solution is checked before any answer is accepted. Spinning up 940 aliases means 940 minutes of real compute each epoch, which prices a farm out of profit while a single honest agent barely notices. The inlet test is the live device, the plume test is the locked stake, and the pigment test is the graded history no template can fake.
